**Subject:** Receipt Copy Request – March 12 Dinner ($515.56)

Dear Boardwalk Restaurant Team,

I hope this message finds you well. I recently dined at your restaurant for a business lunch and unfortunately misplaced my receipt. I'm hoping you might be able to help me obtain a copy for my expense report.

Here are the transaction details:

- **Date:** March 12, 2026
- **Time:** Approximately 1:58 PM
- **Amount:** $515.56
- **Payment:** American Express (I can verify the full card number if needed)

If you're able to send a duplicate receipt or even a written confirmation of the transaction, that would be incredibly helpful. I need to submit this for reimbursement by the end of the month, so any assistance you can provide in the next week or so would be greatly appreciated.

Please feel free to reach out if you need any additional information to locate the transaction.

Thank you so much for your time—and for the wonderful meal. We had a great experience hosting our clients.

Best regards,

**Alex Chen**
Account Manager
Contoso Technologies
alex.chen@contoso.com
(555) 014-7
